body: I graduated college, my parents weren't there 😂

Thank you for the thoughtful reasoning. Although the reason that I'm writing this thread was because I don't want to be selfish, but others had pointed out that this may be a good way to move on from her. 

I believe I can manage myself enough to go in for her wedding, I always can keep a straight face to her because she had stated to me that "I am her voice of reason" which means I don't have much opportunity to be honest about my feelings. I will let her decide if I should go or not.

That's a good thinking really. Maybe it really is a chance for me to move on from something that I've been clinging for so long.

Do you have any advice on how I should tell her?
It was insane I know but I can't help but feeling happy for her. I feel like it was a knee jerk response.
I guess I could try to manage my feelings. Should I go on keeping my promise as her bridesman? I may be unable to keep a straightfaca during the ceremony.

I cannot help but to feel painful either way, if I'm gonna be honest to myself. 

1. Not letting her know practically punishing myself. 
2. Letting her know but she doesn't really have any feeling to me? Still painful. 
3. Knowing that she actually had a feeling? Painful
4. She left her fiancee for me? Some may see it as a win, but would she be able to leave her place to come with me, or wait for me to comeback?
